meaning:
δρόμος, -ου, ὁ
(δραμεῖν, see: τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;]
a course: figuratively, of life or ministry, Act.13:25 20:24, 2Ti.4:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not…
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
